identification: Framed metal cover printing plate (relief block, lettering in mirror image) for David Lake's book 'The Men Who Made the Celebrated Chairs: Windsor chair making in Tasmania' (about Launceston chairmaker George Peddle). The central image is a paper print of the cover drawing (two bearded chairmakers either side of a Windsor chair, rising sun) set into the plate. Timber frame, brown mount, 34 x 24 cm. Armitage estimate 40-70.
